description: Documents the specific error scenario of API-069 (Create Sample Collection) where organizationId/branchId in the request do not match the accession test's actual organization/branch (tenant isolation). Same endpoint as API-069, isolated here to preserve the docs/API_Contracts_and_Test_Results.xlsx functionality numbering.

body.organizationId: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' - does not match the accession test's organization in this scenario
body.branchId: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' - does not match the accession test's branch in this scenario

validation: organizationId and branchId must reference existing organizations/branches, and must match the referenced accessionTestId's tenant scope

success.status_definition: N/A - this functionality ID documents only the failure path; see API-069 for the success contract

errors.condition: organizationId/branchId does not reference an existing organization/branch (or does not match the accession test's tenant scope)

notes: The test scenario supplies non-existent organization_id/branch_id values, which fail the NOT NULL FK constraints directly. A true cross-tenant check (existing org/branch that simply doesn't own the accessionTestId) must additionally be enforced at the API layer, since the FK alone does not verify that accessionTestId belongs to the supplied organization/branch.
